facts.business: Western Ministil Limited is a listed company with no stated business activity in the provided excerpts; the auditor notes the company is not carrying on any activity.

auditor.name: M/s. Maark & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: (1) Company has not made provision for interest on borrowing from a related party since April 1, 2001; loss understated by Rs. 2.87 lakhs (quarter) and Rs. 11.48 lakhs (year); aggregate interest not provided up to March 31, 2026 is Rs. 286.68 lakhs. (2) Accumulated losses exceed paid-up share capital and free reserves; company not carrying on any activity, material uncertainty exists on going concern basis; insufficient evidence to substantiate restructuring efforts.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to accumulated losses exceeding paid-up capital and free reserves, and no business activity
Non-provision of interest on related party loans since 2001, understating losses
Dependence on restructuring efforts not substantiated by evidence
facts.related_party_note: Loans availed from related parties with interest not provided since April 1, 2001; aggregate unprovided interest Rs. 286.68 lakhs as of March 31, 2026.
